claims.data-firehose-faq-lambda-result-paramete: Records that a Lambda function transforms must be returned to Firehose with three required parameters; otherwise Firehose rejects the records and treats them as a data transformation failure.
claims.kinesis-data-streams-agent-installs-on-l: You can install Kinesis Agent on Linux-based server environments such as web servers, log servers and database servers. After installing it, you configure the files to monitor and the stream for the data.
claims.kinesis-data-streams-agent-monitors-file: Kinesis Agent is a stand-alone Java application that collects data and sends it to Kinesis Data Streams. It continuously monitors a set of files, sends new data to your stream, and handles file rotation, checkpointing and retry on failures.
claims.kinesis-data-streams-consumer-restart-re: Shard processors that are migrated to other instances restart processing records from the last checkpoint, which results in duplicated record processing.
claims.kinesis-data-streams-failed-worker-other: If a worker or application fails, the failure is not detected, and other instances of the application run on other EC2 instances, the workers on those instances create additional record processors for the shards that the failed worker no longer processes.
claims.kinesis-data-streams-faq-sse-free-with-a: If you use the AWS-managed KMS key for Kinesis and do not exceed the AWS Free Tier KMS API usage costs, your use of server-side encryption is free.
claims.kinesis-data-streams-kinesis-data-analyt: Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics for SQL is listed among the AWS services in full shutdown, with an end of support date of January 27, 2026.
claims.kinesis-data-streams-kpl-role-retry-batc: The Kinesis Producer Library is an intermediary between your producer code and the Kinesis Data Streams API actions. It writes to one or more data streams with an automatic and configurable retry mechanism, and it aggregates user records to increase payload size and improve throughput.
claims.kinesis-data-streams-getrecords-does-not: The GetRecords operation does not block. It returns immediately, either with data records or with an empty Records element.
claims.kinesis-data-streams-switch-modes-no-dis: Switching a data stream between on-demand and provisioned mode does not disrupt the applications that use it, and you can continue writing to and reading from the stream. During the switch, the stream status is Updating.
claims.msk-case-deputy-msk-consolidate-stream-i: Deputy implemented Amazon MSK, a fully managed streaming data service for Apache Kafka.
claims.msk-case-cisco-self-managed-kafka-burden: Before Amazon MSK, the original Cisco Webex observability stack ran on self-managed Kafka, which needed constant certificate management, upgrades and scaling.

data-firehose-cross-account-and-cross-re.quote: Amazon Data Firehose supports data delivery to HTTP endpoint destinations across AWS accounts. The Firehose stream and the HTTP endpoint that you choose as your destination can belong to different AWS accounts.

Amazon Data Firehose also supports data delivery to HTTP endpoint destinations across AWS regions. You can deliver data from a Firehose stream in one AWS region to an HTTP endpoint in another AWS region. You can also delivery data from a Firehose stream to an HTTP endpoint destination outside of AWS regions, for example to your own on-premises server by setting the HTTP endpoint URL to your desired destination.
For these scenarios, additional data transfer charges are added to your delivery costs.
